title: Warm Lentil and Tomato Salad
blurb: A simple warm salad of tender lentils tossed with fresh tomatoes, dill and spring onions.
steps: Rinse the lentils in cold water and drain well.
Put the lentils in a saucepan with plenty of cold water and bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until tender but still holding their shape.
While the lentils cook, cut the tomatoes in half, scoop out the seeds with a teaspoon, then dice the flesh into small pieces.
Trim and finely chop the spring onions, peel and finely chop or press the garlic, and roughly chop the dill.
Drain the cooked lentils well and tip them into a serving bowl while still warm.
Add the tomatoes, spring onions, garlic and dill to the warm lentils.
Drizzle over the olive oil and vinegar, season with salt and pepper, then toss everything together gently and serve warm.
